name: How can I prevent main sewer line clogs in my Las Vegas home?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent main sewer line clogs in my Las Vegas home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing main sewer line clogs in your Las Vegas home involves mindful waste disposal and regular maintenance. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper, and never pour grease or oil down drains, as these are common culprits for blockages. Consider installing drain screens to catch hair and food particles. Due to the arid climate, tree roots seeking water can be a particular concern, so be aware of trees near your sewer lines. Regular professional inspections and cleanings, especially if you have mature landscaping, can proactively address potential issues before they escalate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by avoiding flushing non-toilet paper items, not pouring grease down drains, using drain screens, and being mindful of tree roots in the Las Vegas environment. Regular professional cleaning helps.
